core: Glutamate-family amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: urea cycle, ornithine/arginine and ammonia handling
name: Urea cycle, ammonia and glutamate-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their inherited defects, ornithine/arginine/citrulline, glutamate/glutamine/proline/aspartate metabolism and ammonium homeostasis, which distinguishes them from confusables centred on aromatic, sulfur, glycine or TCA/gluconeogenic metabolism.

name: Forebrain patterning and anterior pituitary development
rationale: All three members concern forebrain dorsoventral patterning/morphogenesis and adenohypophysis development, unlike confusables about hindbrain/neural plate, spinal cord, neuroblast division or cortical migration.

name: Interferon-gamma signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: All members describe type II interferon receptor signaling and its regulation, whereas confusables concern Th1/IL-12 induction of IFNG production or IL-10/IL-27 family signaling.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Copper, manganese and transferrin/heme iron transport
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese transport/homeostasis together with transferrin, heme and ferroportin iron handling, distinguishing them from iron-only confusables and cadmium-detoxification confusables.

qualifier: cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and RHOBTB adaptors
name: Cullin neddylation and regulation of protein stability
rationale: Members combine neddylation/COP9-signalosome deneddylation, RHOBTB cullin-adaptor GTPase cycles and positive regulation of proteasomal degradation/stability, unlike confusables about PD-L1 degradation, chaperonin folding or deubiquitinases.

qualifier: with direct alkylation reversal and TET/TDG active demethylation
name: Base excision repair, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members span glycosylase recognition, AP-site processing and gap filling plus MGMT/ALKBH alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation, which the OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1-defect confusables lack.

core: Muscle cell growth and differentiation control
qualifier: both vascular smooth muscle and cardiomyocytes
name: Vascular smooth muscle and cardiomyocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, migration and adaptation of both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle cells, whereas confusables are vascular-remodeling-only or heart-morphogenesis-only.

name: Olfactory, cranial nerve and craniofacial gland development
rationale: Members cover nose/olfactory nerve and GnRH neuron migration, trigeminal/facial nerve and cranial ganglia, taste papillae, and lacrimal/salivary gland branching, unlike hindbrain and inner-ear confusables.

core: Innate receptor signaling to NF-kappaB and stress MAPKs
qualifier: TAK1/IKK hub downstream of TLR, NOD and TNFR
name: TLR, NOD and TNFR signaling via TAK1/IKK to NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe TAK1/IKK/NIK-mediated canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 activation from TLR, NOD, TNFR-family and immunoreceptors, whereas confusables concern T cell activation, endosomal TLR deficiencies or cytokine production.

qualifier: excitatory, neurexin-neuroligin, PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering
name: Neuroligin-driven excitatory postsynapse assembly and NMDA receptor clustering
rationale: All members concern neurexin-neuroligin-driven postsynaptic membrane assembly with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, distinct from inhibitory (gephyrin/GABA) and generic synaptic-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance, RUNX1 hematopoietic programs, erythroid and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation and myeloid progenitors, whereas confusables emphasize granulocyte/monocyte differentiation and non-hematopoietic RUNX targets.

qualifier: antibacterial and antifungal killing and agglutination
name: Antibacterial and antifungal innate killing and agglutination
rationale: Members concern host killing, agglutination, metal sequestration and neutrophil cytotoxicity against bacteria and fungi, while confusables center on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

name: Prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX-driven prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and prostanoid and leukotriene GPCR signaling, unlike confusables on leukotriene/lipoxin synthesis or P450 eicosanoid metabolism.

core: Renal regulation of blood volume and pressure
name: Renin-angiotensin and natriuretic renal control of blood pressure
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signaling, renal sodium/urine excretion and guanylyl cyclase-cGMP signaling in systemic pressure control, which confusables on vasoconstriction, endothelin or angiotensin metabolism lack.

name: COPII and COPI vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members cover COPII cargo loading and ER export plus COPI-coated budding, tethering and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, unlike ERAD/ER-retention and Golgi-organization confusables.

name: Fatty acid oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members span alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation of fatty acids and bile acid synthesis from 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol with linked spastic paraplegia defects, which peroxisome biogenesis and lipid-synthesis confusables lack.

core: Sulfur and selenium amino acid catabolism
qualifier: plus choline/FMO oxidation and carnitine synthesis
name: Sulfur amino acid, selenium and choline catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, selenoamino acid metabolism, choline catabolism with FMO oxidation and carnitine synthesis, distinguishing them from confusables on sulfide oxidation, B6, BH4 or aromatic amino acids.

qualifier: chromosome cohesion/condensation, spindle, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic chromosome cohesion, spindle, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span sister chromatid cohesion and condensation, centromere assembly, spindle and centrosome regulation, nuclear envelope breakdown/reformation and cytokinesis, unlike confusables on replication chromatin, meiotic recombination or APC/C.

name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, sperm axoneme and mucociliary clearance plus nodal-cilia left-right organ asymmetry, which multiciliogenesis and CSF-flow confusables lack.

name: Cortical spindle orientation and astral microtubule stabilization
rationale: Members concern spindle orientation/localization via astral microtubules, cortical protein localization and microtubule stabilization, unlike centrosome-localization and tubulin-modification confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: nutrient-sensing ChREBP, LXR, SREBP, PPARA and circadian receptors
name: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are glucose/fatty acid-responsive transcriptional programs (ChREBP, LXR, SREBP, PPARA, PGC-1alpha, ROR/REV-ERB) controlling lipogenesis, triglycerides and gluconeogenesis, unlike adipogenesis or glucagon-PKA confusables.

name: Cholinergic transmission via choline uptake and nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis, SLC5A7 choline uptake, release and nicotinic receptors at neuromuscular synapses, distinguishing them from muscarinic, NMJ-assembly and clostridial-toxin confusables.

qualifier: break sensing, end joining and pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, end joining and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ and regulation of HR versus NHEJ, whereas confusables concern resection, BRCA/PALB2 homologous recombination and SSA.

name: Mitotic spindle orientation and astral microtubule organization
rationale: All four members concern spindle assembly, localization and orientation through astral microtubules, unlike centrosome-recruitment, neuroblast division or centrosome-localization confusables.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis via Rac-WAVE Arp2/3 actin polymerization
rationale: Members link Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12 signaling to Rac/WAVE-driven Arp2/3 actin polymerization for phagocytic cups and lamellipodia, which Fc-inhibitory, BCR and RAC-cycle confusables lack.
